{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ministry of Industry''' of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] was the branch of government responsible for the administering and oversight of corporate ventures. The ministry and its officers were unable to keep pace with the demands of a modern [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], thereby allowing unscrupulous companies to take advantage of natural resources on [[Planet/Legends|planets]], especially involving [[Mining/Legends|mining]] actions.
